mechanics: Tongue high and front, lips spread, held long. Contrasts with short /ɪ/.

interference.label: shortened to KIT
interference.fix: Hold it longer and spread the lips: sheep, not ship.

mechanics: Slightly lower and more central than /iː/, relaxed, short.

interference.label: lengthened to FLEECE
interference.fix: Keep it short and lax: ship, not sheep.

description: Short mid front unrounded vowel (phonetically [ɛ] in modern RP).
mechanics: Jaw half-open, tongue front, lips neutral. Don't raise it to [eː].

interference.label: raised close-mid [eː]
interference.fix: Open the jaw a little more; DRESS is short and open-mid.

description: Short open front unrounded vowel (modern RP [a]).
mechanics: Jaw open, tongue low and front. In modern RP it is quite open — between [æ] and [a].

interference.label: raised to DRESS
interference.fix: Drop the jaw further for TRAP.

description: Short open-mid central unrounded vowel (modern RP [ɐ]).
mechanics: Jaw half-open, tongue central and relaxed, lips unrounded. Not [ɑ] and not [ə]-weak.

interference.label: backed / lengthened
interference.fix: Keep it short and central.

mechanics: Jaw wide open, tongue low and back, lips neutral and unrounded. No /r/ after it unless a vowel follows.

interference.label: BATH said with TRAP
interference.fix: BATH words (ask, chance, demand) take /ɑː/ in RP.

interference.label: rhotic /r/ after START
interference.fix: car /kɑː/ — no /r/.

mechanics: Jaw open, tongue low and back, lips lightly rounded. Short.

interference.label: closer [ɔ]
interference.fix: Open the jaw more and keep it short.

interference.label: unrounded (American) [ɑ]
interference.fix: Add light lip-rounding.

description: Long mid back rounded vowel (close-mid in modern RP).
mechanics: Tongue back and mid-high, lips firmly rounded, long. Non-rhotic: board /bɔːd/.

interference.label: shortened to LOT
interference.fix: Lengthen and round more firmly.

interference.label: too close [oː]
interference.fix: Slightly lower the tongue.

description: Short near-close near-back rounded vowel (centralised in modern RP).
mechanics: Short and lax, lips lightly rounded.

interference.label: lengthened to GOOSE
interference.fix: Keep it short: full, not fool.

description: Long close back (fronted in modern RP) rounded vowel.
mechanics: Lips rounded, tongue high; modern RP fronts it towards [ʉː].

interference.label: shortened to FOOT
interference.fix: Lengthen: pool, not pull.

mechanics: Tongue central and relaxed, lips neutral, long. Absolutely no /r/ colouring.

interference.label: rhotic NURSE [ɝ]
interference.fix: Keep the tongue tip down; work /wɜːk/.

description: Short mid central unstressed vowel — the most frequent vowel in English.
mechanics: Completely relaxed tongue and lips, very short. Occurs only in unstressed syllables and weak forms.

interference.label: full STRUT
interference.fix: Relax and shorten; it should almost disappear.

interference.label: spelling pronunciation
interference.fix: Unstressed "a" is /ə/: about /əˈbaʊt/.

mechanics: Start mid-front and glide up: the jaw closes slightly during the vowel.

interference.label: monophthong [eː]
interference.fix: Add the glide up to /ɪ/: make /meɪk/.

description: Closing diphthong from an open central [a] to [ɪ].
mechanics: Open jaw, then glide up and forward.
Rounded back start, then glide to front unrounded.

description: Closing diphthong from central [ə] to [ʊ] — the signature RP vowel.
mechanics: Start with an unrounded central schwa, then round the lips as the tongue glides back and up. Never a flat [oː].

interference.label: monophthong [oː]
interference.fix: Start unrounded and central, then glide: go /ɡəʊ/.

interference.label: back start [oʊ]
interference.fix: Begin centrally, not back-rounded.

mechanics: Open jaw, then glide back and round the lips.

description: Centring diphthong from [ɪ] to [ə] (often [ɪː] in modern RP).
mechanics: Glide from KIT towards schwa. No /r/.

interference.label: rhotic NEAR
interference.fix: here /hɪə/ — no /r/ before a consonant or pause.

description: Centring diphthong, monophthongised to long [ɛː] in modern RP.
mechanics: Long open-mid front vowel; no /r/.

interference.label: rhotic SQUARE
interference.fix: care /keə/ — no /r/.

description: Centring diphthong from [ʊ] to [ə]; many speakers now use /ɔː/ in sure/poor.
mechanics: Glide from FOOT to schwa, or use /ɔː/. No /r/.
Close both lips, release with aspiration [pʰ] at the start of a stressed syllable.
Close both lips; voicing is weak word-initially.
Tongue tip on the alveolar ridge, released with aspiration [tʰ]; often a glottal stop [ʔ] before consonants in modern RP.

interference.label: retroflex [ʈ]
interference.fix: Tongue tip forward on the alveolar ridge, not curled back.

interference.label: dental [t̪]
interference.fix: Move the tip back off the teeth onto the ridge.

mechanics: Tongue tip on the alveolar ridge; voiced.

interference.label: retroflex [ɖ]
interference.fix: Flat tongue tip on the alveolar ridge.

mechanics: Back of the tongue against the soft palate; aspirated [kʰ] initially.
Back of the tongue against the soft palate; voiced.
Upper teeth lightly on the lower lip, steady airflow.
Upper teeth on the inside of the lower lip with audible friction and voicing — not a frictionless [ʋ].

interference.label: approximant [ʋ]
interference.fix: Press the teeth into the lip and make it buzz.

interference.label: merged with /w/
interference.fix: Teeth contact for /v/; none for /w/.

mechanics: Tongue tip lightly behind or between the teeth, continuous airflow — no stop.

interference.label: stopped to [t]/[t̪]
interference.fix: Let air flow continuously over the tongue.

mechanics: As /θ/ but voiced — feel the buzz.

interference.label: stopped to [d]/[d̪]
interference.fix: Continuous voiced friction, no closure.

mechanics: Tongue blade near the alveolar ridge, sharp hiss.
As /s/ with voicing. Plural -s after voiced sounds is /z/.
Tongue further back than /s/, lips slightly rounded.
As /ʃ/ with voicing.
Breathy release before a vowel; never after a vowel.
Stop + /ʃ/ release as one sound.
Stop + /ʒ/ release as one sound.
Lips closed, air through the nose.
Tongue tip on the alveolar ridge, air through the nose.

interference.label: retroflex [ɳ]
interference.fix: Tip forward on the ridge.

mechanics: Back of the tongue on the soft palate; in "-ing" no [ɡ] release.

description: Alveolar lateral approximant (clear before vowels, dark [ɫ] before consonants and pauses).
mechanics: Tongue tip on the ridge, air over the sides.

interference.label: retroflex [ɭ]
interference.fix: Tip forward on the ridge.

description: Postalveolar approximant [ɹ] — only before vowels in RP.
mechanics: Tongue tip approaches (but doesn't touch) the back of the ridge, lips slightly rounded. Never after a vowel unless a vowel follows.

interference.label: tap/trill
interference.fix: No contact — an approximant.

mechanics: Tightly rounded, protruded lips with no tooth contact, gliding into the vowel.

interference.label: labiodental [ʋ]
interference.fix: Keep the teeth away from the lip; round instead.

interference.label: merged with /v/
interference.fix: No friction for /w/.

mechanics: Tongue front raised towards the hard palate; RP keeps /j/ in new /njuː/, tune /tjuːn/.
